info.title: Sabz Zendegi API
info.description: REST API for Sabz Zendegi clinic services.

refreshCookie.name: __Host-sz_refresh
refreshCookie.description: HttpOnly refresh cookie. Local development uses sz_refresh_dev.

weightKg.description: Decimal value serialized as a string.

treatmentTaskId.description: Optional matching MEDICATION task in the same treatment plan.

discountCode.description: Optional commerce discount code; the server canonicalizes and prices it.

refundStatuses.description: Read-only refund lifecycle statuses for a verified order payment.

amountToman.description: Positive integer TOMAN for FIXED_AMOUNT only.

evidenceReference.description: Non-sensitive bank-transfer reference or evidence locator; required only when completing a refund

tombstone.description: Safe tombstone shown instead of restricted text.

reporterNote.description: Optional non-sensitive note; never message or medical text.

requestImmediateBlock.description: Request an effective pending-review conversation-scoped block.
